return_method: Median first 2 s versus stationary standing 65–85 s; subsequent lying excluded. User confirms same physical location, no surveyed ground truth.

heldout_walls.method: Same fixed ROI/normal as legkilo-backend-map-2026-09-09.json; includes physical structure/noise.

clock.scope: Accepted clock-output trace; does not prove acquisition-to-output latency or unknown cross-sensor hardware skew.

kinematic_pairing.method: Replay bag ordering, 512-key LowState cache and eight pending Sport packets as backend; unique six-axis IMU key. Callback scheduling can differ live.
kinematic_pairing.note: Bag arrival skew is not measurement timestamp skew.

stance_velocity_disagreement.method: Each force>35 leg implies body velocity -(J*dq + gyro cross foot_position). Deviation from mean of currently selected legs. Every fifteenth matched packet. Diagnostic uses threshold, not contact hysteresis.
stance_velocity_disagreement.interpretation: Larger disagreement during walking; consistent with imperfect contact/kinematic velocity observations. Does not individually identify slip, encoder filtering or force calibration.

decision.meaning: Ten times larger observation covariance reduces trust in stance-foot velocity. Existing contact/FK/IMU processing retained.

interpretation: Excessive weight on imperfect stance-foot velocity is a demonstrated contributor to this walk drift. Reduced weight improved circle return at both playback rates and held-out wall spread. Widening loop correspondences alone did not solve return. This is parameter correction of existing backend, not a new SLAM algorithm.
limitations: Weak-kinematics circle return varies 0.039 m at 2x versus 0.733 m at 1x. Both have 1913 identical output timestamps and identical initial pose/bias; numerical poses first differ at frame 579 (~37.663 s). Exact cause of replay sensitivity not established; scheduling, matching and numerical ordering not isolated. Do not claim 4 cm accuracy.
Floor-normal tilt median/p95 on circle changed from 1.644/3.467 degrees to 1.057/4.303 degrees in 2x replay: endpoint gain is not uniform geometry improvement.
Force-based contact velocity disagreement does not uniquely diagnose slip, encoder filtering or calibration.
No walking test on updated live Jetson configuration yet.
No new end-to-end Wi-Fi latency measurement; accepted source clock traces do not establish acquisition timing.
validation: Seven offline runs on unchanged amd64 binary; saved map and trajectories nonempty. YAML copied to isolated Jetson checkout and SHA256 verified. Existing session ownership retained.
